sn31.23-112:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn31.23-112:1.3: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sāragandhe adhivatthānaṃ devānaṃ …pe…
sn31.23-112:1.12: idha bhikkhu ekacco kāyena sucaritaṃ carati vācāya sucaritaṃ carati manasā sucaritaṃ carati
sn31.23-112:1.14: gandhagandhe adhivatthā devā dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahulāti.
sn31.23-112:1.16: aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā gandhagandhe adhivatthānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyanti.
sn31.23-112:1.27: so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā gandhagandhe adhivatthānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
sn31.23-112:1.28: ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā gandhagandhe adhivatthānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatīti. (
sn31.23-112:2.1: evaṃ ekapiṇḍikena ekasatañca dvādasa ca suttantā bhavanti ).
